messages.content: 如果我從紐約出發，途經費城、華盛頓特區和亞特蘭大，最後抵達邁阿密，預計的旅行時間會是多少？另外，如果我不停留在亞特蘭大，直接從華盛頓特區前往邁阿密，會是多少時間？最後，如果我從改成從費城出發，停留華盛頓特區，然後抵達邁阿密，會是多少時間？

function.name: route_estimate_time
function.description: Estimate the travel time for a specific route with optional stops. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

start_location.description: The starting point for the journey.

stops.description: Additional cities or points of interest to stop at during the journey ordered.

message.reasoning:
We need to estimate travel times using the tool "route_estimate_time". We have three scenarios:

1) Start NYC -> Philadelphia (费城), Washington DC, Atlanta, Miami.

2) Start NYC -> Philadelphia? Wait second scenario says if not stopping in Atlanta, directly from Washington DC to Miami. So start NYC -> Philadelphia -> Washington DC -> Miami. But maybe they still include Philadelphia as first stop? They said "directly from 华盛顿特区前往迈阿密" meaning skip Atlanta but keep other stops presumably including Philadelphia and Washington DC. Yes likely path: NYC->Philadelphia->Washington DC->Miami.

But we should confirm: In original question: "如果我从纽约出发，途经费城、华盛顿特区和亚特兰大，最后抵达迈阿密，预计的旅行时间会是多少？另外，如果我不停止在亚特兰大，直接从华盛顿特区前往迈阿密，会是多少时间？最后，如果我从改成从费城出发，停留华盛顿特区，然后抵达迈阿密，会是多少时间?" Actually third part: "if I change to depart from Philadelphia, stay in Washington DC, then reach Miami." That implies start at Philadelphia instead of New York; so path: Philadelphia -> Washington DC -> Miami.

Thus we will call function thrice accordingly.

The function signature expects start_location, end_location, stops array. Default stops includes ["NYC"] but we override.

So calls:

First: start="New York", end="Miami", stops=["Philadelphia","Washington D.C.","Atlanta"]

Second: start="New York", end="Miami", stops=["Philadelphia","Washington D.C."] (skip Atlanta)

Third: start="Philadelphia", end="Miami", stops=["Washington D.C."]

We'll produce results. Use function calls via JSON. We'll output each result separately. Let's do it.
